messages:
Zoe: tiny follow-up from the console pass — spotted three related nits: table zebra stripe contrast, inconsistent hover elevation on primary/ghost buttons, and a choppy toast motion that a few folks found jarring. want to bundle small fixes into a compact tokens pass?
Maya: +1. for zebra stripes what ratio are we at now? I remember some rows dropped below AA in dark mode.
Carlos: current: row-bg-even = #0f1113 (contrast 3.8:1 with body text), row-bg-odd = #0b0c0d (contrast 4.2:1). dark-mode even row is marginal. proposal: shift even row up to #131516 which gives ~4.6:1.
Zoe: sounds good. please note this affects our visual density — might make rows feel busier. maybe only apply zebra at > 600px width and remove on dense mobile tables?
Ethan: agreed on conditional zebra. CSS idea:
```
.table--zebra { background-size: auto; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .table--zebra { background: none; } }
```
Maya: hover elevation inconsistency: primary button uses elevation-2 on hover, ghost uses only a 1px outline. they feel mismatched in the toolbar. propose ghost hover get subtle shadow + outline to match perceived depth.
Carlos: +1 but let's keep shadow very soft: box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) and outline remains our focus token for keyboard. also add a token `hover-elevation-ghost: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`.
Zoe: perfect. last one: toast motion. noticed the slide+fade combo is sharp. some folks with reduce-motion preferences still get a lot of movement because we animate transform extensively.
Ethan: UX research flagged that too. Proposal: if `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` then make toasts fade only, no translate, and shorten animation to 160ms. else default 300ms slide+fade.
Maya: also copy nit on toasts: undo text reads "Undo changes" but context sometimes expects "Revert" which is clearer when action undoes a save. can we make toast copy use contextual verb token `toast-undo-verb` with default "Undo" but override per action?
Carlos: yes — small API change in the toast component to accept `verb` prop. default 'Undo', but callers can pass 'Revert' or 'Cancel'. please document in the component README.
design-a11y-bot: Automated accessibility checks recommended:
- Zebra update in dark mode raises contrast to 4.6:1 (AA pass).
- Ensure zebra removal at small widths maintains row focus visibility (add `:focus` background accent).
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce transform and animation duration to <=160ms.
- Button hover shadow must not reduce text contrast; check in high contrast mode.
:white_check_mark: all checks pass for proposed tokens.
Zoe: action list: 1) Carlos to bump dark zebra color and add responsive rule to hide zebra under 600px; 2) Carlos to add `hover-elevation-ghost` token and update ghost hover styles; 3) Ethan to implement reduced-motion toast variant and shorter durations; 4) Maya to add `toast-undo-verb` token and update common usages; 5) update Figma and component docs, then QA for keyboard focus in zebra-less mobile.
Maya: i'll update copy tokens and patch a couple toast callsites in the dashboard flows.
Carlos: i'll open a small PR with the color/token changes and include screenshots for dark/light modes.
Ethan: i'll handle the motion pref patch and add tests for animation durations.
Zoe: thanks team — small batch but should fix a lot of polish complaints. post Figma + PR links here when ready and i'll sign off. :sparkles:
